selector.champion: FIP1L1-PDGFRA–positive chronic eosinophilic leukemia (CEL) with associated generalized eruptive histiocytosis (GEH)
selector.rationale: The presence of the FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene, hypereosinophilia, elevated tryptase, and elevated vitamin B12 levels, along with skin biopsy findings of nodular infiltration of histiocytes with lymphocytes and eosinophils, strongly supports the diagnosis of FIP1L1-PDGFRA-positive CEL with associated GEH.

rejected.label: Hypereosinophilic syndrome
rejected.why: Lack of specific diagnostic criteria and presence of FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene points towards a more specific diagnosis

rejected.label: Eosinophilic Disorder
rejected.why: Too broad and nonspecific given the presence of FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene and other specific findings

rejected.label: Histiocytosis
rejected.why: While histiocytosis is present, it is part of a larger syndrome (FIP1L1-PDGFRA-positive CEL with GEH) that better explains all findings

rejected.label: Eosinophilic dermatosis
rejected.why: Does not account for the systemic findings such as hypereosinophilia and FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene
